# aws-api-gateway

REST vs HTTP API differences that change findings: authorizers, payload format, throttling defaults, 29s integration timeout and pricing model.

## Recipes

- `apiforge model api-gateway --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge model asyncapi --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge knowledge show aws-api-gateway`
- `apiforge judge` then filter findings by rules AF-GW-001, AF-GW-002, AF-GW-003, AF-GW-004, AF-GW-005, AF-GW-006, AF-GW-007
